# `⌈` — Ceiling / Maximum

Function. Keys: `Alt-s`. Ranks: `0` monadic, `0 0` dyadic

`⌈Y` rounds up to an exact integer. Pervasive; tolerant near integers. An infinity or NaN stays a float. Complex ceiling is `-⌊-Y`.

```bpl
⌈1.2 ¯1.2         ⍝ [2 ¯1]ₓ
⌈3r2              ⍝ 2ₓ
```

`X⌈Y` takes the real maximum. Pervasive. Beside NaN, `X⌈Y` gives NaN or the other argument. `⌈/` and `⌈\` give NaN or the greatest other item. Which one depends on the processor and the code path. Remove NaNs first where that matters, as in `⌈/(v=v)#v`. Empty reduction identity: `¯∞`.

```bpl
3⌈1 5             ⍝ 3 5
3⌈1 $n 5          ⍝ 3 $n 5
```
